summary: > “"No need for waterworks, Drippy is here to help!"”
> Drippy is the virtual assistant for K.O.L. (Kinemantik Online) in 1999.
sections: Drippy is featured as a mascot in Höllvania Central Mall as well as in various 1999-themed items. They appear in an animation loop on some TV screens on the Höllvania tile set, including the television screens in the Backroom.
- Drippy is a reference to Clippit, more commonly known as Clippy, a discontinued Office Assistant for Microsoft Office.
